description: Single source of truth for the Emscripten toolchain pin and compile/link flags. Consumed by wasm_renderer/build.sh (via scripts/format-wasm-compile-flags.js; the only build), scripts/emcc-version-gate.sh and the CI wasm job (setup-emsdk version must equal emsdkVersion). Export lists live in wasm_exports.json. ASYNCIFY is required by device.cpp WaitAny init — see wasm_renderer/BUILD_FLAG_EXPERIMENTS.md before touching it. GROWABLE_ARRAYBUFFERS=0 is deliberate (TextDecoder + resizable heap); do not flip without a Dawn re-test. extraFlags are plain em++ args (compile + link); -flto adopted 2026-10 (-12.5 KB .wasm); -fno-rtti adopted 2026-10-18 (-189 B, and a tripwire against typeid/dynamic_cast). -fno-exceptions, -sENVIRONMENT=web[,worker], -msimd128, --closure 1 and the ASYNCIFY_* narrowing were measured and not adopted; see BUILD_FLAG_EXPERIMENTS.md. Debug / ASan builds are `profiles` (wasm_renderer/build.sh, WASM_PROFILE). `sources` is the one translation-unit list (build.sh and `npm run wasm:compdb` both read it).

debug.description: Local debugging build (`npm run wasm:build:debug`). -O0 + DWARF + a source map so Chrome DevTools steps through the C++; ASSERTIONS=2 and SAFE_HEAP=1 trap bad heap access with a stack instead of corrupting silently. -flto is dropped (slow link, no debug value at -O0). The output goes to wasm_renderer/build/debug/ and is never copied to public/wasm/: the committed artifact is always the release build. `asan` is opt-in on top (WASM_ASAN=1) and drops SAFE_HEAP, which ASan refuses to link with.
